name: chemistry-sketcher

scripts.dev: pnpm run build:deps && concurrently -k -n core,shared,client -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @starter/chem-core run dev" "pnpm --filter @starter/shared run dev" "pnpm --filter @starter/client dev"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:deps && pnpm --filter @starter/client run build
scripts.build:deps: pnpm --filter @starter/chem-core run build && pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build
scripts.build:client: pnpm run build:deps && pnpm --filter @starter/client run build
scripts.test: pnpm run build:deps && pnpm run test:core && pnpm run test:client
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:deps && pnpm -r run typecheck

description: Chemical structure editor for publication figures
